title: Finitely presented modules locally free at primes are finite projective
statement: Let $R$ be a ring and $M$ an $R$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. If $M$ is finitely presented and $M_{\mathfrak p}$ is free over $R_{\mathfrak p}$ for every prime ideal $\mathfrak p$, then $M$ is finite projective.
